notes.title: Wasteland Waste Disposal is now Windpunk 🌀
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148201/438ea8731f33ac674f7d0cd6132064a3c28f4154.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone, We’ve got some exciting news to share: Wasteland Waste Disposal is now officially called Windpunk! [/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/0F01DVuRuyA"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]This isn’t a sudden shift in many ways, it’s just catching up with what the game has already become. From day one, [i]Wasteland Waste Disposal[/i] was about rebuilding, restoring, and finding beauty in the aftermath. Over time, the wind-powered traversal, kinetic tools, and storm-healing mechanics became core to that vision. So, we’re giving it a name that matches the soul it’s always had.[/p][p][/p][p]✨ [b]Why the name change?[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Trademark clarity[/b]: To avoid potential conflict with the [i]Wasteland[/i] series, we wanted to make sure the project could grow freely without legal hang-ups.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Identity alignment[/b]: The word [i]Windpunk[/i] better captures the hopeful, windswept, energy-driven theme that’s now central to the gameplay and the world.[/p][/*][/list][p]🛠️ What’s changing?[/p][list][*][p]Just the name. The story, tone, and spirit are the same.  A cozy, scrappy survival-crafter in a storm-scarred world.[/p][/*][*][p]You still pilot your Mech-Ark, recycle and refine ruins, recruit a quirky crew, and ride gliders through gusty skies.[/p][/*][*][p]The Steam page and trailer have been updated, but your wishlist/follow stays intact.[/p][/*][/list][p]🗓️ [b]This update was announced as part of the [i]Moonlite Madness Summer Showcase by NeverMore Niche[/i] (June 26, 2025)[/b] [/p][p]Thank you so much for being part of this journey. Whether you joined us for the storms, the bots, the mixtapes, or the wind donuts, this story is still yours.[/p][p]See you out there. [/p][p]– Kluk 🌱[/p]
